en.text: The scattered use of sound effects resembling wailing and groaning creates an eerie, uncomfortable sensation.

original: 体の調子が悪く、授業に遅れてしまいました。

en.text: I wasn't feeling well and was late for class.

original: よほど具合が悪くなければ、昼間、横になるなんて夢のまた夢だ。

en.text: Until the day I become unwell, me lying down during the day is in your dreams.
Me lying down during the day is in your wildest dreams, that is, until the day I fall ill.
Unless I turn extremely unwell, lying down during the day is a distant dream.

original: アニメの映像はどれも気味が悪かった。

en.text: All of the anime visuals were creepy.

original: 居心地が悪かったから、出た。

en.text: I felt uncomfortable, so I left.

original: 居心地が悪かったから、とんずらしてみた。

en.text: I had a bad feeling, so I tried to flee.

original: 来るタイミングが悪かったようだ。

en.text: It looks like I've come at a bad time.

original: まあ、それほど悪くはなかったよ。

en.text: Well, it wasn't all that bad.
Well, it wasn't that bad.

original: 気持ち悪くて、不気味。それにちょっと怖かった。

en.text: I had a bad feeling about it, it was creepy. A bit scary, too.

original: ほら、そんなに悪くなかったでしょ。

en.text: See? That wasn't so bad.
